handoff_note: The VS-3/VS-4 staleness bug is closed at the root and the pointer was corrected through the log (event 01KZ1XZC051V9SCVE583TSM35C), not by editing STATE.json. A zombie lease from the dead token-16 session was reaped first, which burned token 17 and added one tombstone - so crash_rate rose to a still-red value by design; it is an honest record of a session that really did die, not a regression. O1 stays closed; O2/O4 unchanged; O3 (GitHub repo) still needs a human in v0 settings. VS-4 remains open: succession workflow is the largest unbuilt DoD item, plus escrow/mirror and dead-man prod wiring
intent: close the orphaned RED increment left by the session that died at token 16: give the phase/slice pointer its own event (slice.transitioned) and let ADRs be announced on the log (decision.recorded), so a mid-phase slice change is derivable from events alone instead of requiring a forbidden hand-edit of STATE.json (ADR-008 D44/D45)
reason: STATE.active_slice read VS-3 for three days while VS-4 was in progress. compaction was correct; the vocabulary was incomplete - slice was only derivable from a session.started payload, so 'the slice changed mid-phase' was an unsayable statement. The only apparent fix was retyping STATE.json, which SS3.1 forbids and the pre-tool hook blocks, so the gap created structural pressure to violate I1. decision.recorded was likewise missing, so ADR-007 could not be recorded on the log at all

rollback.evidence: full gate green after the change (157 tests / verify 6 / sim 30) and the cold-restore drill re-derived the pointer from events in a throwaway root
rollback.method: drop slice.transitioned + decision.recorded from events.EVENT_TYPES and the schema enum, remove cmd_slice and its subparser from fsp.py, remove the slice.transitioned branch in compact.py. Emitted events stay on the log and become unknown-type rows: raw events are immutable (SS3.2), so revert un-ships the code, never the history

verification.evidence: 157/157. The 4 tests were written RED by the previous session and left orphaned; they failed with EventLogError 'unknown event type slice.transitioned' and argparse 'invalid choice: slice' before this change

the load-bearing check: in a scratch root, emitted slice VS-1->VS-7 phase P3-drill, DELETED state/STATE.json, ran compact.py --rebuild, and the snapshot came back active_slice=VS-7 phase=P3-drill from the event log alone. A green test alone would not prove this, since a test can read the cache it wrote

an agent that does not hold the lease is refused with exit 1 and a message naming the real holder and token; an unclaimed workstream is allowed, so bootstrap and cold-restore drills stay possible (D45)

caught during self-review: ADR-008 initially reused D43, already consumed by ADR-007. Renumbered to D44/D45. The first decision.recorded event (01KZ1XZBY5HVZQTZE7C960B1XS) was NOT edited; a superseding event (01KZ1Y88S3X7VSAT2Y27HQGQWR) carries the corrected numbers, per SS3.2
